rain_mm_day.description: FuXi 24-hour mean precipitation rate converted to daily rainfall.

weekly_total_mm.description: Seven consecutive, non-overlapping UTC model periods.

calendar_interpolation.description: Interpolation is applied to each yearly mean before averaging years.

model_anomaly.expression: forecast weekly mean − matched model-climatology weekly mean
model_anomaly.description: FuXi model anomaly; not an IMD or IMERG anomaly.

imerg_anomaly.expression: IMERG observation − IMERG Final V07B 2001–2022 calendar-day climatology
imerg_anomaly.description: Satellite observation anomaly using the fixed audited baseline.

area_weight.description: Weights are normalized across finite supported cells for scores.

statistics.climatology_spread: sample standard deviation across 20 yearly means (ddof=1)
statistics.terciles: 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles across 20 yearly ensemble means
statistics.verification: Bias, MAE, RMSE, and weighted spatial Pearson ACC use identical valid periods, target grid, India support, and weights.
